My dear [Miss Bussell](/person/232)
Many thanks for your portrait which I like very much, & will try to put in.[^2]

yours truly

C M Yonge


[^1]: A card with rounded corners, of the same type as
[^2]: Euphemia Bussell, ‘A Brief Memoir of the late Mrs Anne Elinor Prevost’ MP (April 1883) 380-4.
